part2_package_census.THE_FINDING: FIVE mutually inconsistent plugin counts are in simultaneous circulation, and they are not all the same KIND of number: 51 (directories on disk), 48 (CLAUDE.md and C07), 46 (C01 section 3), 43 (PLUGIN_CATALOG rows the runtime advertises), 30 (ALL_PLUGINS ids that actually contribute at boot). Only the first is a census; the last two are capability. A doc that says '46 plugins' is wrong by 5 against disk AND wrong by 16 against what boots.
part2_package_census.CLAUDE_md_explanation_is_also_wrong_in_k: CLAUDE.md says 'two entries under packages/ carry no manifest, so count manifests, not directories'. Measured: EVERY one of the 103 directories under packages/ has a manifest - the loop above printed nothing. The 2-entry delta is two loose JSON FILES (tsconfig.build.template.json, tsconfig.references.json), not manifest-less directories. The instruction happens to give the right answer for the wrong reason, which means it will stop giving the right answer the moment a real manifest-less directory appears.

booleans.measured: workflows_total = 8 (ci.yml, context-bake.yml, deploy-fly.yml, r2-cors.yml, r2-sync-items.yml, r2-sync-textures.yml, terrain-bake-all.yml, terrain-bake.yml). GitHub Actions REST API returns HTTP 404 (private repo; GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_PAT / PRYZM_GH_PAT all unset; no gh CLI on PATH) so RUN STATUS COULD NOT BE READ REMOTELY. Determined LOCALLY instead: ci.yml:424 runs 'pnpm run ga-gate:all' -> tools/ga-gate/run-all.ts WHOLESALE inside the ga-gate job, which ci.yml:25 states is MERGE-BLOCKING with no continue-on-error. run-all.ts:115 and :141 register check-cast-count.ts and check-layer-boundaries.ts. BOTH exit 3 at HEAD. run-all.ts:1162-1172 sets anyFailed=true on code===3 UNCONDITIONALLY (RATCHET-EXCEEDED-IS-NEVER-DEBT, R7/L-836) - exit 3 is never absorbed by any ledger. gate-debt.json failing[] = ['check-no-commandmanager.ts','check-custom-event-apps.ts'] ONLY; neither failing gate is on it.

'all_workflows_green == workflows_total' over a denominator that is 75 percent manual-only is a weak predicate before you even measure it. (b) The one workflow that matters is deterministically RED at this SHA - established from the gate exit codes plus run-all's own absorption logic, not from a checkmark. This is the SECOND of C01's five ACHIEVED booleans that is measurably false.

score.measuredGenerous: 3/9 TRUE (#3, #5, and #4 counted despite its one tolerated rival)
score.delta: TWO of C01's five ACHIEVED booleans do not hold. #2 is a SCOPE ARTEFACT (src/ui does not exist; the successor scope has 70 casts and the P4 gate exits 3 at 101/100). #6 is measurably FALSE (the merge-blocking ga-gate job fails at HEAD on two exit-3 ratchets that no ledger can absorb). #1 was never true and cannot become true as worded. Phase F is gated at >= 6/9 and the measured figure is 3/9 at its most generous - and #7, #8 and #9, which ARE Phase F, are all independently confirmed FALSE, so the two halves of the rule agree.

crossCuttingObservations: THE SAME DEFECT SHAPE APPEARS INSIDE A GATE'S OWN OUTPUT: check-single-compose.ts:216 prints the literal '0 rivals' after line 166 of the same run printed 'rival runtime factories: 1'. A gate that hard-codes a number in its success line has stopped reporting its own measurement.

RC=0 IS NOT 0 VIOLATIONS, three times over in this phase: check-l7-boundary RC=0 at 83/84 files; check-plugin-census-equivalence RC=0 at 24 dark plugin directories; check-single-compose RC=0 at 1 tolerated rival. check-raf-count RC=0 is the only genuine hard invariant of the four gates that passed.

TWO GEOMETRY PACKAGES ARE UNCLASSIFIED (@pryzm/geometry-boundary-line, @pryzm/geometry-handrail). The layer gate states explicitly that it 'cannot judge any import to or from them' - so every edge into or out of two element-family geometry packages is unmeasured, and the unclassified ratchet just moved 13 -> 15.

THE ELEMENT-CREATION COMMIT PATH IS THE SDK BYPASS. Roughly 57 of the 83 renderer-three bypasses are the committer/geometry-bridge/material-bridge triple repeated across 19 element plugins. This is not drift; it is the only route a family currently has to the scene.

FOUR OF THE FOUR ARMS of check-layer-boundaries are over baseline simultaneously (105/102, 186/182, 123/113, 15/13). All four are shrink-only. The gate exits 3, which run-all treats as unabsorbable, so this single gate is sufficient to make ci.yml red.
